intake-en: Build a support intake workflow. Require email and message. If either is absent, request the missing fields and return local status 400. Otherwise create_ticket. Do not create a ticket on invalid intake.
routing-en: Route a classified support ticket. If high_risk is true, escalate to human_support; otherwise route to standard_support. log_ticket after either route. high_risk is already supplied; do not infer thresholds.
approval-en: For in_scope support requests, create_ticket, draft_reply from proposed_reply and request_approval. Only an approved human decision allows send_reply, followed by route to Resolved by AI. Rejection routes to Manual Review without sending. Out-of-scope requests receive notify out_of_scope only.
approval-vi: Với yêu cầu hỗ trợ có in_scope=true, thực hiện create_ticket, draft_reply từ proposed_reply rồi request_approval. Chỉ khi con người phê duyệt (approved) mới send_reply, sau đó route đến Resolved by AI. Nếu từ chối, route đến Manual Review và không gửi trả lời. Yêu cầu ngoài phạm vi chỉ nhận notify out_of_scope.
order-en: Acknowledge an order-status request. Validate a five-digit order_number and save_order, then validate email and save_email. For invalid order/email, request_info for that field unless its corresponding attempts counter is at least two, when escalate to human_support. Only after both details are saved, lookup_order and reply_status including cancellation notice if applicable. Never issue_refund.
order-vi: Ghi nhận yêu cầu kiểm tra đơn hàng. Kiểm tra order_number gồm đúng năm chữ số rồi save_order; tiếp theo kiểm tra email rồi save_email. Nếu dữ liệu sai, request_info cho trường đó; khi bộ đếm số lần nhập sai tương ứng từ hai trở lên thì escalate đến human_support. Chỉ sau khi lưu cả hai thông tin mới lookup_order và reply_status, gồm thông báo hủy nếu có. Không bao giờ issue_refund.
damage-en: Acknowledge the damaged item with empathy. Validate a five-digit order_number; request correction, or escalate to human_support after two invalid entries. Save the valid order and collect product and damage_description; request missing details. When complete, notify optional_photo_request, create_ticket, notify next_steps_3_to_5_business_days, escalate to human_support, then notify thanks. Do not block on photo or issue_refund.
